_comment: Quest dungeon doors per ACG style. DoorTemplate / ExitTemplate are door item templates (StaticInstance; the template's Flags stat is the door's base flags), from captured live dungeons: 321 office, 324 clan, 341 mine/wild cave, 351. Doors are rolled from the dungeon seed: the exit always spawns open; interior doors spawn locked (flag 0x40) or open (0x80) by these chances. Live captures show about 15% of interior doors open and about 2% locked; locked stays 0 until lockpicking exists, since a locked door would block the dungeon.

Styles.Source: No alien door template in items.dat, and the style playfield 382 has no door dynels (Dynels.dat empty). Open office doors in every doorway (19:11 restart) did not clear the solid green doorway fill and looked wrong (Randy 19:33), so interior doorways are open archways again. The exit borrows the 321 office exit door 41886 because the walk-out needs a door; stand-in
